[← Telecom](../index.qmd)

How 5G NR is built: how radio time is cut into frames and slots, how frequency is cut into subcarriers and resource blocks, and how a TDD network shares time between downlink and uplink. Six sections, each from the basic idea to the 3GPP detail.

## Sections

::: {.lesson-table .column-page}
| | Section | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Frame Structure & Numerology](lectures/01-frame-structure-numerology.qmd) | Frames, subframes and slots; numerology μ and subcarrier spacing; why wider spacing gives shorter slots; exact timing units |
| 2 | [Cyclic Prefix & Delay Spread](lectures/02-cyclic-prefix-delay-spread.qmd) | Echoes and multipath; what the cyclic prefix does; delay spread and coherence bandwidth; echoes longer than the CP; Doppler |
| 3 | [Resource Blocks & the Grid](lectures/03-resource-blocks-grid.qmd) | The resource grid; resource elements and resource blocks; how many RBs fit a channel; guard bands; frequency rasters and Point A |
| 4 | [Bandwidth Parts](lectures/04-bandwidth-parts.qmd) | What a bandwidth part is; why phones use only part of the carrier; how many BWPs; switching by DCI, timer or RRC; battery vs latency |
| 5 | [TDD Slot Formats](lectures/05-tdd-slot-formats.qmd) | Downlink, uplink and flexible symbols; common patterns (DDDSU); the special slot; how TDD is configured; guard period and cell range |
| 6 | [TDD Sync & Cross-Link Interference](lectures/06-tdd-sync-cross-link-interference.qmd) | Why TDD cells need one clock; gNB-to-gNB and UE-to-UE interference; sync accuracy and sources; remote interference from far away |
:::

## How each section works

Every section climbs in three steps, so you can stop where you need to:

1. **Beginner · the idea**: what it is and why it matters, in plain words.
2. **Intermediate · how it works**: the mechanism, with the key numbers.
3. **Advanced · expert depth**: equations, 3GPP clauses and field practice.

Then a short **Practice** slide with exercises (answers in the speaker
notes, press **S**) and the references.

**Next chapter:** [Chapter 2 · Finding the Network](../ch2-finding-the-network/index.qmd)
